con.text: Millennia before the Conflux, Progenitus unleashed five storms to consume creation, until Cylia wounded it with a poisoned dagger, saving life on Alara though the plane had separated into Shards; two of its heads withered away and it slumbered under Naya's soil.

Fifteen years before the Conflux, Progenitus began to awaken in the Second Stirring, appearing to Mayael to ask for Cylia, while Bolas co-opted its image to tell her to build an army against Sarkhan Vol's dragons.
Guided by Mayael's visions of Progenitus, Naya's elves, Nacatl and behemoths marched to war with Bant and Jund.
At the Conflux, black and blue mana flooded Naya and Progenitus awakened, the Soul of the World returned, and the Ancient Ziggurat emerged again.
